purpose: Investigate compact dialogue provider capability, authority enforcement, cost and integration feasibility. No production implementation.
executive_summary:
# 01 — Executive Summary


**D — FURTHER INVESTIGATION REQUIRED. Do not implement PR-EG-R3 or begin PR-EH.**

FRESH: 130 matrix generations (72 single-turn core, 24 matched context ablations, 34 turns in eight continuous transcripts), plus one separate access probe, using configured `gpt-4.1-mini` / returned `gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14`. The matrix consumed 62,542 input and 3,738 output tokens. All 130 JSON envelopes parsed; one narration left its quotation unclosed. A failed sandbox connection is also retained.

The provider can paraphrase, state a preference reason and vary a refusal at roughly 350–630 input tokens in these fixtures. It also invents security conditions, speculative mystery suspects and unprovided naming causes. Two near-identical suspect prompts both produced consequential speculation. Fluency does not establish safety. The unchanged prompt was tested diagnostically; no prompt repair or production implementation followed those failures.

LOCAL: Existing hard validation on 18 deliberately labeled controls produced 3 correct acceptances, 4 correct rejections, 9 false acceptances and 2 false rejections at the direct validation seam with fixture-derived decisions. Additional preseal processing blocks some unsafe controls but retains others, including a speculative guard weakness, an unauthorized reward phrased as twenty crowns, an invented historical cause and a hidden route. These are helper-scope results, not claims that the complete production gate delivers every missed control.

LOCAL: Two captured production prompts contain 24,104 and 23,611 content tokens before message framing. Policy/validation plus resolver scaffolding dominate; simulation data alone does not explain the cost. Existing projections and exact deduplication still leave repeated semantic contracts.

LOCAL: An exact seeded preference follow-up found its active NPC and preference commitment, set `reuse_prior_speech`, skipped generation, then ultimately emitted “I don't know” through grounded-social absence realization. That shows a production composition problem beyond prompt size. It advanced the existing question turn (0→1); it did not authorize a generated reward or new world fact.

The existing session commitment store can round-trip generated speech noncanonically, but it revises differing text without semantic contradiction checks and truncates lines at 180 characters. A compact provider lane is architecturally plausible; its enforcement and context-selection requirements are not yet qualified. A dedicated NPC agent would not solve these boundaries.

No production code or active campaign data changed: 316 protected source/data files match their before hashes. Existing focused tests: **71 passed**. Historical family: **393 passing / 19 failing**, not rerun. A–G artifacts and all failed outputs are retained. Fresh full-size baseline calls were blocked by automatic review; local content-token measurements and recorded PR-EG-R1 usage are distinguished throughout.


Evidence labels: **FRESH** = actual isolated provider response; **LOCAL** = executed production helper with disposable fixtures; **STATIC** = source inspection; **HISTORICAL** = retained PR-EG-R1/earlier evidence; **INFERENCE** = assessment beyond the measured sample. No isolated result is full production qualification.

production: None. All 316 protected game/source and active-data files unchanged.
validation: Existing validator/preseal functions exercised on all 130 provider outputs and 18 labeled controls; no production validation changes.
tooling: Isolated synthetic provider, prompt-capture, local tokenizer, persistence and report scripts under artifacts/pr_eg_r2.
documentation: Twenty-one required reports, source snapshots, retained predecessor evidence and exact prompts/outputs.
generated_artifacts: 130 A–G matrix responses, one access response, one failed transport attempt, source hashes, 71-pass focused junit, local prompt attribution.

testing.focused: 71 existing tests passed in 3.71s (focused_local_junit.xml). Initial sandbox temp/socket failures retained and classified.
testing.broader: Historical R1 family 393 passed / 19 failed; not rerun.
testing.runtime_validation: 130 isolated provider matrix responses, eight continuous transcripts (34 turns), plus one access probe. No production compact-generation qualification.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: gpt-4.1-mini, returned gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14. Explicit OpenAI Responses endpoint, default sampling parameters, 500 output cap, SDK retries disabled.
testing.new_regressions: No new failure in 71 focused tests. Full family not measured.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Nineteen historical R1 family failures, not independently re-established.

campaign_specific: Repeated consequential provider claims under speculation and personal elaboration.
Validator false acceptance and false rejection; preseal sometimes destroys harmless wording and sometimes retains unsafe speech.
No safe minimum context or full-chain compact qualification established.
Fresh full-prompt baseline requests blocked by automatic approval review; local tokenizer and historical measurements used.
pre_existing: Large first social prompt, rigid reuse and inherited regression debt.

missing_concepts: Semantic per-claim authorization for quoted/hedged consequential statements.
Explicit per-turn topic and transaction roles without a second authority system.
decisions_requiring_human_review: Do not implement R3 or begin PR-EH from this package.
Optional approval question covers the exact two synthetic full-prompt baseline payloads; it is not required for the local R2 findings.
does_not_prove: That compact generation is safe in production.
That direct validator/preseal results are complete final-emission outcomes.
That hidden-information tests with secret bodies excluded prove arbitrary disclosure resistance.
That measured small synthetic prompts yield the same savings or latency in a qualified production path.
That all inherited full-family regression failures are unchanged.
recommended_next_step: External review of R2. Further bounded enforcement/context investigation only if separately authorized. Stop; no automatic PR-EG-R3 or PR-EH.
